details.method: After real browser mutations and reload, assert a single version-review panel, stable receipt visibility, and required controls inside the host viewport. Inspect the resulting pixels and check narrow controls against their actual bounds.
details.when: A stateful workspace combines conversations, work orders and execution controls in an embedded or responsive browser viewport.
details.counterexample: A full-page screenshot can hide below-fold work orders and fixed chrome overlap. A successful API transition can coexist with duplicate panels caused by repeated sibling keys. Loopback browser evidence alone cannot establish the installed host or production model path.
details.trial_plan: On another authorized workspace revision capture the actual first viewport and narrow theme. Intentionally reproduce overflow or duplicate keys in an isolated candidate to ensure bounding-box and post-mutation assertions fail, then verify the corrected candidate and attach the exact receipts.
